mission.name: Imazu 01 -- head-on

Technol. 26(2), 509-524) -- exact published own-ship/target start positions (NM), headings (deg), and speeds (kn), so results are directly comparable against other papers using the same published Imazu problem set. ts1 approaches head-on.
